inherits.anchor_rule: D-005 armed-episode first entry (see WP1 contract anchor_definitions as amended)
inherits.partition: development leaf only; confirmation leaf untouched; cutoff 1773619200000000000 ns
inherits.causal_clock: availability = received_ts_ns, tie-break = source_sequence; emitted_events fields never knowable before episode end

objective: Produce the first complete Drift-Burst behavioral result on the development leaf: lifecycle atlas, six-horizon market paths, internal-attribute splits, and the frozen support/noise reference for later candidate screening.

cohort.anchors: first lawful entry per (armed episode, state) for WEAK, ONLINE, STRONG, DECAY_RISK, DYING, per D-005 rule
anchor_record: anchor mid = (bid+ask)/2 of the anchor tick; bid/ask recorded

internal state at anchor: operational z/score/efficiency/var_rate/cabs/update_count/duration_s/net_log/direction, authority score_30s/score_60s, multiscale 5s/15s/30s/60s (z, score, efficiency, direction, duration_s, var_rate), milestones crossed so far with ts
episode age at anchor (anchor_ts - origin_ts), state age (anchor_ts - state entry ts)
multiscale agreement: count of agreeing scale directions (5s/15s/30s/60s) and boolean all-agree
left_truncated flag (episode in progress at leaf start)

per_episode: origin (ts, price, direction), arm path (which forming window armed), milestone ladders with latencies from origin
state sequence with entry/exit times, re-entry counts (DECAY_RISK re-entries, DYING re-entries), decay_recoveries
peak: level, points, ts, latency from origin and from each milestone
termination: end_reason, end ts/price, duration origin->end, censor status
burst_points, burst_duration_to_peak_s, completion fields recorded as episode-end facts only
population_tables: occupancy/re-entry table (consecutive state-bearing rows, per WP1 report table for continuity)
dwell distributions per state (tick count and wall seconds; median/quartiles)
termination end_reason distribution by entry state and by direction
censoring: right-censored episodes at cutoff (none expected; dev leaf ends IDLE per WP1), left-truncated count
state persistence: P(next state | current state, first-entry) and conditional on re-entry

market_paths.price: mid = (bid+ask)/2 of ticks; windows measured in availability time from the anchor tick's received_ts_ns
market_paths.horizon_rule: horizon window = ticks with availability in (anchor_avail, anchor_avail + h*1e9]; if the leaf ends or a data gap truncates a window, record missingness with last covered offset; no imputation
measurements_per_window: signed return (raw) and direction-adjusted return (multiplied by anchor direction/internal_sign)
MFE: max favorable excursion (direction-adjusted) and its timing offset ms; MAE: max adverse excursion and timing offset ms
favorable_before_adverse: boolean from first-occurrence timing; adverse_before_favorable: boolean; tie flagged
continuation distance = direction-adjusted MFE magnitude; reversal distance = direction-adjusted MAE magnitude (explicit mapping; both stored)
realized variance: sum of squared per-second bucket log-returns within the window (buckets by floor(avail/1s); empty buckets excluded)
path efficiency: net log return / sum of |per-tick mid log changes| within window; 0 moves -> null
missingness columns per horizon: covered_ns, complete boolean, censor reason
market_paths.normalization: raw values stored; normalized values = return / baseline_IQR(h) of the frozen noise reference; basis recorded alongside

internal_attribute_splits.bands: per attribute, quintile edges computed over the development anchor population of the corresponding anchor state; edges frozen into the reference artifact; raw values always retained alongside band labels
categorical_attributes: milestones already crossed (WEAK/ONLINE present at anchor)
session block (per lake analytical_session_authority named windows)
outcomes_conditioned: each horizon's direction-adjusted endpoint return, MFE, MAE, realized variance
internal_attribute_splits.rule: continuous variables stay continuous in evidence; band tables are readable summaries only

support_noise_reference.purpose: frozen before WP3/WP4 outcomes are opened (plan §11); basis for candidate screening and materiality
support_noise_reference.baseline_paths: pseudo-anchors at every 500th development tick (deterministic row index i % 500 == 0 among state-bearing rows), same six horizons, same measurements, no conditioning; stored as the movement baseline
support_noise_reference.materiality_rule: a conditional effect is material when |median direction-adjusted return difference vs the same-horizon baseline median| >= 0.10 * baseline_IQR(h)

support_rules.block_rule: effect sign consistent in >= 3 month blocks, each with >= 50 supporting anchors
support_rules.dominance_rule: no single month contributes > 50% of a cell's support
support_rules.direction_stability: sign of median effect consistent across >= 3 blocks AND across both leaf halves (split at development-leaf midpoint availability time)

determinism.rerun: full scan executed twice; output content hashes must match; measured runtime from the second run
determinism.memory: streaming with bounded pending-window buffer (<= ~301 s of ticks plus pending measurements); report peak RSS

deliverables.anchors: AP-001/R2_LIFECYCLE_MARKET/AP-001_WP2_ANCHORS.json (or parquet if larger; sha256 recorded either way)
deliverables.preflight: AP-001/R2_LIFECYCLE_MARKET/AP-001_WP2_PREFLIGHT.json (row counts, anchor counts per state vs WP1, determinism hashes, runtime)

exit_condition: Every anchor has a lifecycle result and market-path result, or an explicit INSUFFICIENT_SUPPORT/missingness status; atlas and splits complete; determinism hashes match; support reference frozen.
interpretation_boundary: The E1 report is frozen, then interpreted by the research analyst. No scanner change after seeing results (defect protocol excepted). No candidate promotion in WP2; candidates form after WP4 per plan §10 flow.
change_rule: Deviations require decision-log entries and director approval before affected evidence is used.
